description: Teaching responsibility matrix fixtures and applied questions for R34-T030 (1.6 Shared responsibility model.md)

question_1.title: Predict an output
question_1.question: What is the evaluated responsible party for the task 'Patch guest operating system' under the 'IaaS' service model?

question_2.title: Diagnose a failure
question_2.question: Why does evaluating {'task': 'Enforce MFA on user accounts', 'service_model': 'SaaS'} fail to assign provider ownership, and how is it evaluated?

question_3.title: Choose a boundary policy
question_3.question: When a workload security task has no assigned responsible party, what boundary policy must be applied: default-to-provider, default-to-customer, or flag as UNASSIGNED?
